data.name: DeveloperModeDescription
data.value:
Lets you modify procedures, functions, triggers and other objects that are in use by active sessions: compiling waits for the object to be released instead of returning an error immediately.
Affects how objects are compiled — not how your SQL runs. It applies when you compile an object in its editor, and when the Script Executor runs a script that only creates or changes objects. The SQL Editor is not affected: it runs every statement in your working transaction, which never waits, so a query or an update can never be left hanging on someone else's lock.
